summary: Quote, then Depth on the same equity: Dhan's quote stream is swapped for its full stream; releasing Quote leaves the full stream, and releasing Depth unsubscribes it. An equity without OI sends oi 0 in Depth, as the web does.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

The web sends Dhan's trade time in epoch seconds as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends ltt in ms and Dhan's last_trade_time in seconds, as the web does.
deviations.ref: dhan_adapter.py:900; feed::dialect (Dhan last_trade_time in seconds, openalgo#2377)

deviations.reason: The desktop sends OI as both oi and open_interest for every broker, as the recorded Zerodha transcript does; this web adapter sends oi only.
The web sends Dhan's OI day high; the desktop's common carrier drops it.
The web sends Dhan's OI day low; the desktop's common carrier drops it.
The web sends Dhan's book depth (5); the desktop's common carrier drops it.
